title: Part 7 真题题型 A
focus: 短信对话、新闻、插句定位、双篇与三篇联读
note: 原创 TOEIC-style 仿真题，不是 ETS 官方真题。

groups.title: Questions 1-2 refer to the following text-message chain.

passages.title: Questions 1-2: Text-message chain
passages.text:
Lena Fischer (10:35): Hi Daniel, the caterer just called. They can't deliver lunch for tomorrow's training session until 12:45.
Daniel Okafor (10:37): That's a problem. The morning session ends at 12:00, and the afternoon speakers start at 1:00.
Lena Fischer (10:39): Could we push the afternoon start to 1:30? I can let the speakers know.
Daniel Okafor (10:42): I'd rather not. Two of them have flights in the evening.
Lena Fischer (10:44): Understood. Then I'll ask the caterer for sandwiches instead of the hot buffet. They said cold items could arrive by 11:30.
Daniel Okafor (10:46): Good idea. Let's go with that. And please order twenty extra bottles of water—it's supposed to be hot tomorrow.
Lena Fischer (10:47): Will do. I'll confirm with them now and send you the updated invoice.
passages.zh:
Lena Fischer (10:35): 嗨 Daniel，餐饮公司刚打电话来。明天培训的午餐他们要到 12:45 才能送到。
Daniel Okafor (10:37): 这就麻烦了。上午的环节 12:00 结束，下午的讲者 1:00 就开始。
Lena Fischer (10:39): 我们能把下午的开始时间推到 1:30 吗？我可以去通知讲者。
Daniel Okafor (10:42): 我看还是别了。他们中有两位晚上要赶飞机。
Lena Fischer (10:44): 明白。那我让餐饮公司改送三明治，不要热食自助了。他们说冷餐 11:30 之前能送到。
Daniel Okafor (10:46): 好主意。就这么办。另外请多订二十瓶水——明天据说会很热。
Lena Fischer (10:47): 没问题。我现在就跟他们确认，然后把更新后的账单发给你。

options.text: To report a change in a delivery time
To confirm a speaker's flight
To ask for a copy of an invoice
To request more bottles of water

questions.explain: 首行 caterer just called… can't deliver until 12:45，通报送餐时间变了。

questions.stem: At 10:42, what does Mr. Okafor most likely mean when he writes, "I'd rather not"?

options.text: He does not want to delay the afternoon session.

He would rather have a hot meal than sandwiches.
He cannot attend the morning session.

questions.explain: 回应上一行 push the afternoon start to 1:30，理由是讲者晚上要赶飞机，即不想推迟。

groups.title: Questions 3-5 refer to the following article.

passages.title: Questions 3-5: Article
passages.text:
VALENCIA (3 June)—Marisol Textiles, a maker of bed and bath linens, will open a new distribution center in Valencia in September, the company announced on Tuesday. The 12,000-square-meter facility will replace a smaller warehouse in Castellón that the company has leased since 2015. According to chief operating officer Ines Barreto, the move will allow orders from online customers to be shipped within one business day instead of three.
Marisol was founded in Alicante in 1998 by brothers Joan and Marc Soler, who still run the company. It sells its products in more than 300 department stores across Spain and Portugal and began selling directly to consumers through its Web site two years ago. Online sales now account for nearly a quarter of the company's revenue. The new center is expected to create about 80 jobs, and the company plans to begin hiring warehouse staff in July.
passages.zh:
瓦伦西亚（6 月 3 日）——床上用品及浴室织品生产商 Marisol Textiles 周二宣布，将于 9 月在瓦伦西亚启用一座新的配送中心。这座 12,000 平方米的设施将取代公司自 2015 年起在卡斯特利翁租用的一座较小的仓库。据首席运营官 Ines Barreto 介绍，此次搬迁将使网上顾客的订单在一个工作日内发出，而不是原来的三天。
Marisol 于 1998 年由 Joan 和 Marc Soler 兄弟俩在阿利坎特创立，两人至今仍经营着公司。其产品在西班牙和葡萄牙的 300 多家百货商店销售，两年前开始通过自家网站直接面向消费者销售。目前网上销售额已接近公司总收入的四分之一。新中心预计将创造约 80 个工作岗位，公司计划 7 月开始招聘仓库员工。

groups.title: Questions 6-9 refer to the following notice.

passages.title: Questions 6-9: Notice
passages.text:
ATRIUM EVENT SPACE — BOOKING GUIDELINES
The ground-floor atrium of Corvin Tower may be reserved by tenant companies for product launches, receptions, and staff events. Bookings are handled by the building management office on the second floor and must be made at least ten business days in advance. [1] The space holds a maximum of 120 guests for standing receptions and 80 for seated dinners.
Tenants are responsible for arranging their own catering. [2] Because the atrium is open to the public during the day, weekday events may begin only after 6:00 P.M. Weekend bookings are available from 9:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. Amplified music must end by 9:30 P.M. so that residents of the neighbouring apartment building are not disturbed.
A refundable cleaning deposit of €300 is required with every booking. [3] The cost of repairing any damage to the floor or planters will be deducted from this amount. [4] To check availability, e-mail atrium@corvintower.hu or call extension 2210.
passages.zh:
中庭活动场地——预订须知
Corvin 大厦一层中庭可供租户公司预订，用于产品发布会、招待会和员工活动。预订由二楼的物业管理办公室受理，须至少提前十个工作日办理。[1] 该场地站立式招待会最多可容纳 120 位来宾，坐席晚宴最多 80 位。
餐饮由租户自行安排。[2] 由于中庭在白天对公众开放，工作日的活动只能在下午 6:00 之后开始。周末可预订时段为上午 9:00 至晚上 10:00。扩音音乐必须在晚上 9:30 之前结束，以免打扰隔壁公寓楼的住户。
每次预订须缴纳 300 欧元可退还的清洁押金。[3] 地面或花箱如有损坏，修理费用将从该押金中扣除。[4] 如需查询场地空闲情况，请发邮件至 atrium@corvintower.hu 或拨打分机 2210。

passages.title: Questions 10-14: E-mail
passages.text:
From: Marta Kowalczyk <m.kowalczyk@lindenlanguage.co.nz>
To: Sione Tuilagi <s.tuilagi@brightwaterconsult.co.nz>
Date: 8 October
Subject: Furniture advertisement

Dear Mr. Tuilagi,

I saw your advertisement in the Harbour Business Weekly. Our language school is opening a second branch in Ponsonby next month, and we need to furnish four classrooms and a small staff room. I would like to take all twelve of the height-adjustable desks, along with the same number of chairs. Could you tell me what price you could offer for that quantity? I would also like to see the boardroom table, as it may suit our teachers' room.

I am free at any time on the viewing date. However, I will be out of the country from 14 October until the end of the month, so I will not be able to collect the items myself. Would it be possible for our driver to pick them up on the 14th? He will bring a signed authorisation letter with him.

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Marta Kowalczyk
Linden Language Centre
passages.zh:
发件人：Marta Kowalczyk <m.kowalczyk@lindenlanguage.co.nz>
收件人：Sione Tuilagi <s.tuilagi@brightwaterconsult.co.nz>
日期：10 月 8 日
主题：家具广告

Tuilagi 先生您好：

我在《Harbour Business Weekly》上看到了贵公司的广告。我们语言学校下个月将在 Ponsonby 开设第二家分校，需要为四间教室和一间小教师休息室配置家具。我想把十二张高度可调办公桌全部买下，再配同样数量的椅子。请问这个数量您能给出什么价格？我还想看看那张会议桌，它可能适合我们的教师办公室。

看货当天我任何时间都有空。不过，我从 10 月 14 日起到月底都会在国外，因此无法亲自来取货。能否让我们的司机在 14 日来取？他会带上签字的授权书。

谢谢，期待您的回复。

Marta Kowalczyk
Linden 语言中心

passages.title: Questions 15-19: Advertisement
passages.text:
HARVEST TABLE CATERING — Office Lunch Packages

Feeding a busy team has never been easier.
Our lunch packages cover everything from a quick working lunch to a full-day training session, and every order is delivered fresh to your office door.

Package A (Sandwich Lunch): assorted sandwiches, fruit, and a soft drink — $12 per person
Package B (Hot Lunch): choice of two hot dishes, rice or salad, and dessert — $19 per person
Package C (Executive Lunch): three-course plated meal with staff service — $34 per person
Minimum order: 10 people. Orders placed online before 3:00 P.M. can be delivered the next business day. Delivery is free within the city centre; a $25 charge applies to all other areas. Vegetarian and gluten-free meals are available for every package at no extra cost—simply enter the number of special meals when you order.
